lines.cyr: не стој спроти мене, изгорев за тебе,
lines.lat: ne stoj sproti mene, izgorev za tebe,
lines.en: don't stand in front of me, I burn for you,

lines.cyr: изгорев за тебе како лен за вода,
lines.lat: izgorev za tebe kako len za voda,
lines.en: burn for you like flax for water,

lines.cyr: како лен за вода, босиљок за сенка.
lines.lat: kako len za voda, bosiljok za senka.
lines.en: like flax for water, basil for shade.

lines.cyr: Гори, лудо, гори, и јас така горам,
lines.lat: Gori, ludo, gori, i jas taka goram,
lines.en: Burn, crazy lad, burn, that's how I burn,

lines.cyr: гори, лудо, гори, и јас така горам,
lines.lat: gori, ludo, gori, i jas taka goram,
lines.en: burn, crazy lad, burn, that's how I burn,

lines.cyr: и јас така горам, нема што да сторам,
lines.lat: i jas taka goram, nema što da storam,
lines.en: that's how I burn, there is nothing I can do,

lines.cyr: и јас така горам, нема што да сторам!
lines.lat: i jas taka goram, nema što da storam!
lines.en: that's how I burn, there is nothing I can do!

lines.cyr: Девојче, девојче, дават ли те тебе,
lines.lat: Devojče, devojče, davat li te tebe,
lines.en: Girl, girl, are they giving you,

lines.cyr: девојче, девојче, дават ли те тебе,

lines.en: girl, girl, are they giving you,

lines.cyr: дават ли те тебе, за мене сиромав,
lines.lat: davat li te tebe, za mene siromav,
lines.en: are they giving you, for me, so poor,

lines.cyr: дават ли те тебе, за мене сиромав?
lines.lat: davat li te tebe, za mene siromav?
lines.en: are they giving you, for me, so poor?

lines.cyr: Мама не ме дава уште годинава,
lines.lat: Mama ne me dava ušte godinava,
lines.en: Mother won't give me for another year,

another year, because I'm too young,
